name: Sportarr
description: Sports metadata provider for Jellyfin. Fetches league, event, and image metadata from your Sportarr server.
overview: Sportarr is a sports media management application (similar to Radarr/Sonarr but for sports). This plugin connects Jellyfin to your Sportarr server to provide rich metadata for your sports media library including posters, banners, descriptions, and air dates.
